name: "Teddy Bear" Strawberry Shortcakes with Lemon Whipped Cream

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE STRAWBERRY COMPOTE: Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice strawberries. Place in a medium bowl along with sugar and vanilla, then stir to combine. Cover with plastic wrap or a lid and place in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (16 oz) pkg strawberries
granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE SHORTCAKE TEDDY BEAR HEADS & SNOUTS: Place flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in the bowl of a stand mixer. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
all-purpose flour
3 tbsp granulated sugar
baking powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly.
Place bowl on a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, then add cream. Mix on low speed until the dough just comes together, 1-2 minutes.

Divide dough into 13 equal-sized pieces; set one piece aside for the next step. Pat remaining 12 pieces into 3-inch wide by 3/4-inch thick disks. Divide disks between two baking sheet pans lined with parchment paper, spacing them 2-inches apart. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Divide the reserved portion of plain dough into 12 small pieces, then roll into balls. Press a ball into the bottom-center of each shortcake to create the bear "snout." Set aside.
FOR THE SHORTCAKE TEDDY BEAR EARS, EYES & NOSES: Place flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup all-purpose flour
granulated sugar
1 ½ tsp cocoa powder
¾ tsp baking powder
salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate more cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly.
Place bowl on the stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, then add cream. Mix on low speed until the chocolate dough just comes together, 1-2 minutes.

Divide and shape the chocolate dough into eye, nose, and ear shapes. Press into the shortcakes to complete the bear heads. Place baking sheets in the freezer until shortcakes are firm, about 20 minutes.
TO BAKE THE SHORTCAKES: While the shortcakes are chilling, preheat oven to 400°F.
Once chilled, remove baking sheets from the freezer, then brush shortcakes with cream.
Place shortcakes in the oven and bake until lightly golden around the edges, 24–26 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.
FOR THE LEMON CREAM: While the shortcakes are cooling, place whipped topping and lemon curd in a clean medium bowl. Stir to combine the lemon cream.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) tub frozen whipped topping
½ cup lemon curd

instructions.primary_message: FOR SERVING: Arrange shortbreads on a serving platter. To assemble, spoon strawberries and lemon cream onto plates, then top with shortcakes. Enjoy!
